findings.title: Missing await on reserve_stock makes stock check always pass
findings.explanation: reserve_stock is async. reserve_fast calls it without await, so ok is always a truthy coroutine, the 409 branch never triggers, stock is never reserved, and coroutine never executed.

evidence.why: reserve_fast is async but calls reserve_stock without await so ok is a coroutine
reserve_stock is async and must be awaited, returns False when insufficient

findings.suggestion: Add await: ok = await reserve_stock(sku, quantity)
findings.verifier_note: Verified: async def in shop/inventory.py:19 vs missing await in new reserve_fast endpoint.

findings.title: N+1 queries in /orders/details loops per-order fetch
findings.explanation: order_details does 1 list_orders query then 1 items_for_order query per order in a Python loop. Query count is O(N), so latency and DB load grow linearly with user history.

evidence.why: loop calls db.items_for_order once per order after list_orders = N+1 queries

findings.suggestion: Batch fetch items with single JOIN or WHERE order_id IN (...) query like receipt_for_order does.
findings.verifier_note: Verified: new endpoint in diff loops per-order queries; JOIN pattern exists in billing/receipt.py.

findings.title: External HTTP request without timeout enables DoS
findings.explanation: remote_stock performs requests.get to external host without timeout. Slow/hanging upstream blocks worker, enabling DoS, with attacker-controlled sku.

evidence.why: requests.get uses f-string URL with sku and no timeout argument

findings.suggestion: Add explicit timeout (e.g., timeout=5) and validate/encode sku.
findings.verifier_note: Verified: new code calls requests.get with no timeout param.

findings.title: Blocking requests.get inside async endpoint
findings.explanation: remote_stock is async but performs blocking requests.get. This blocks the event loop for all requests until remote call completes.

evidence.why: async endpoint uses blocking requests.get, blocking event loop

findings.suggestion: Use async HTTP client (e.g., httpx.AsyncClient) or make endpoint sync def.
findings.verifier_note: Verified: new async endpoint uses synchronous requests.get.
